Formats:
 D.. = Demuxing supported
 .E. = Muxing supported
 ..d = Is a device
 ---
  Ed alsa            ALSA audio output
  E  iamf            Raw Immersive Audio Model and Formats
  E  matroska        Matroska
  E  mov             QuickTime / MOV
  E  mp4             MP4 (MPEG-4 Part 14)
  E  mpegts          MPEG-TS (MPEG-2 Transport Stream)
  E  null            raw null video
  E  webm            WebM
